QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] The Seal of Evil
QuestInfo.1: Dabo claims to have seen some seals committing evil! Head to #bUnderwater Ice Cave 1#k and defeat #r25 Possibly-Evil Seals#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went to #bUnderwater Ice Cave 1#k and defeated #r25 Possibly-Evil Seals#k.

0.0: I couldn't believe me eyes when I saw it, but some of me own brothers was #rsneaking around up to no good#k. They was even using some kinds of tools, and we seals hate tools! They muck up our swimmin' flaps.
0.1: I knew I shoulda told sooner, but I didn't want to get me friends in trouble...
0.2: They'll be down abouts the #bUnderwater Ice Cave#k. Don't be too hard on 'em, would ya? One of 'em owes me twenty clams.

yes.0: Those #rPossibly-Evil Seals#k are just gonna ruin all that hard work we've been doin'.\r\n#b#e(Eliminate #r25 Possibly-Evil Seals#b in Underwater Ice Cave 1.)\r\n

no.0: I don' think the situation's gonna get any less ugly by ignorin' it.

1.0: W-what? Those fellas were wearing #bseals for hats#k?

yes.0: Wha' kinda creeps are we dealin' with here? I put on three stone just frettin' o'er the whole situation.
